meta.guide_tau: Level caption:  energy (NIST, or a measurement of the last 20 years where one exists) and measured lifetime (where one exists).
meta.notes: Bergeson & Lawler 1993 lifetimes could only be read through an automated reader of the publisher's page (full text paywalled); every value carries its cross-check against Wood 2014, and the four without one (44206.099, 44336.1, 48735.29, 49403.386) should be verified against the PDF before being treated as final. Isotope shifts are nu(60Ni)-nu(58Ni), derived from compiled wavelengths, sign as computed. Wood 2014 level energies equal the NIST ones to <0.1 cm-1 (matched within 0.3 cm-1 and J). rme_J_ea0 derived from A (S = A g_upper lambda_vac^3 / 2.0261e18). 61Ni: I=3/2. WebSearch was unavailable in this session (budget exhausted).
